scope: profile after full64lane diagnostic baseline; instrumented HTTP timing is not serving comparison
collection_policy: launch session -> same-condition warmup96 -> start recording -> retained96 -> stop recording -> graceful session shutdown; do not truncate/trim traces
clock_policy: record realtime, monotonic and monotonic_raw pairs at phase boundaries; inspect exported clock metadata before correlating GPU and HTTP clocks
analysis_policy: GPU kernel/memcpy/API spans reported separately; derive interval unions and intersections; do not add overlapping durations; CPU stack/OSRT are diagnostic estimates; unavailable scheduler/HTTP attribution stays unmeasured
failure_policy: preserve all artifacts and stop on errors, missing CUDA data, numerical/protocol mismatch or unreclaimed owned GPU resources; no slow sample removal
compatibility_pending: launch/start/stop flow verified in installed CLI help; actual CUDA13 collection and CPU sampling still unverified
